The V60 Recharge plug-in hybrid powertrain delivers responsive performance while optimizing fuel efficiency through its advanced turbocharged engine paired with electric capability. The AWD system provides confident handling across varying road conditions, and the Geartronic automatic transmission ensures smooth acceleration and precise control.

Inside, the cabin reflects Volvo's commitment to comfort and technology. Nappa leather seating surfaces, heated front sport bucket seats, and heated rear seats create an inviting environment for all occupants. The front seats feature memory functionality and power adjustment, allowing you to customize your driving position precisely. The power moonroof adds an open-air ambiance, while the heads-up display presents essential driving information directly in your line of sight.

Entertainment and connectivity are seamlessly integrated through the Bowers & Wilkins premium sound system featuring 15 speakers and SiriusXM satellite radio. The Sensus Navigation system with Apple CarPlay provides intuitive route guidance and access to your favorite applications. Multiple power windows, steering wheel-mounted audio controls, and remote keyless entry ensure convenience throughout your drive.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. This 2024 Subaru Outback Onyx Edition XT offers a compelling combination of capability and refinement for drivers who value both performance and practicality.

- All-Weather Floor Liners
- Auto-Dimming Exterior Mirror with Approach Light
- Rear Bumper Cover
- Splash Guards
- Subaru STARLINK 11.6" Multimedia Plus System

- Power Moonroof
- Heated Front Bucket Seats

The Onyx Edition XT delivers responsive performance through its 2.4L DOHC engine paired with CVT Lineartronic transmission, producing impressive fuel efficiency with an EPA rating of 22 city and 29 highway miles per gallon. Standard all-wheel drive ensures confident handling across various driving conditions, while the four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering provide a smooth, controlled ride whether you're navigating city streets or venturing off the beaten path.

Inside, the cabin reflects thoughtful design with premium features including a power moonroof that floods the interior with natural light, heated front and rear seats for comfort during colder months, and a heated steering wheel for added convenience. The Subaru STARLINK 11.6" Multimedia Plus System puts modern connectivity at your fingertips, while the harman/kardon® audio system with 12 speakers delivers superior sound quality for your favorite music and podcasts.

Safety remains a priority with Subaru's comprehensive approach, offering dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags throughout the cabin. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, brake assist, and a rear-view camera provide additional layers of protection and confidence on every journey. The STARLINK Safety Plus emergency communication system offers peace of mind with three years of complimentary service.

Practical touches abound, from the power liftgate that simplifies cargo loading to all-weather floor liners that protect your investment. The roof rack expands your carrying capacity for gear and equipment, while the split-folding rear seat adapts to accommodate both passengers and cargo as your needs dictate.

This Outback combines utility, comfort, and dependable engineering to support your active lifestyle. Experience the versatility and refinement that define the Subaru Outback by visiting our showroom today.

This 2024 Outback Onyx Edition XT represents quality, reliability, and thoughtful design that will serve you well for years to come.

  • Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life. When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident. Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead.
  • Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety. Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision.
  • Rear camera - Watching your back! The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. The rear camera is an extra set of eyes that's both convenient and safe.
  • Predictive brake assist - Be prepared for your big brake. Predictive brake assist monitors the available distance in front of you compared to your vehicles speed. If your speed exceeds the required distance to stop short of a collision, it readies your brakes to apply maximum stopping force when you use them. This 2024 Subaru Outback Onyx Edition XT combines refined styling with practical capability, delivering a vehicle designed for those who value both comfort and performance on every drive.

- Adaptive Cruise Control
- EyeSight Driver Assist Technology
- All Wheel Drive with X-MODE
- Lane Keep Assist and Lane Departure Warning
- Blind Spot Monitoring and Rear Cross Path Detection
- Pre-Collision Braking
- Power Moonroof
- Heated Front and Rear Seats
- Heated Steering Wheel
- Leather Seats
- Navigation with 11.6" Subaru STARLINK Multimedia Plus System
- Harman/Kardon Speakers with 12 Total Speakers
- Power Liftgate with Memory Height
- Keyless Entry and Push Button Start
- New Brakes

Finished in brown exterior paint, this Outback presents a distinctive appearance while the 18-inch black aluminum-alloy wheels complete the polished look. The cabin welcomes you with leather seating throughout, driver's seat memory settings, and heated front and rear seats for year-round comfort. The heated steering wheel and heated exterior mirrors round out the climate control options, ensuring comfort in various weather conditions.

The Onyx Edition XT is equipped with Subaru's EyeSight Driver Assist Technology, which combines adaptive cruise control with lane keep assist and pre-collision braking to help enhance safety during your commute. Blind spot monitoring and rear cross path detection provide additional awareness, while the backup camera offers clear visibility when reversing. Navigation is integrated into the 11.6-inch touchscreen multimedia system, making it simple to plan your route and access entertainment through Bluetooth connectivity and SiriusXM satellite radio.

Power conveniences define the driving experience, including power front seats, power moonroof, and a power liftgate with memory height setting that remembers your preferred opening height. The steering wheel is fully adjustable with tilt and telescope functions, and audio controls are mounted directly on the wheel for easy access without taking your hands from driving position. HomeLink garage door transmitter integration allows you to control your home from the vehicle.

The 2.4L DOHC engine paired with CVT Lineartronic transmission delivers efficient performance, achieving 22 mpg city and 29 mpg highway. All-wheel drive with X-MODE ensures capable traction in varied driving conditions, while the independent four-wheel suspension provides a balanced ride. The vehicle sits on 18-inch wheels wrapped in all-season tires with new brakes providing confident stopping power.

This 2024 Outback Onyx Edition XT represents a well-equipped mid-size SUV ready to support your lifestyle. With demonstrated attention to safety, comfort, and technology integration, this vehicle invites you to experience what intelligent automotive engineering offers. We encourage you to schedule a time to visit our showroom and explore this opportunity firsthand.

Dual-zone automatic climate control keeps all occupants comfortable regardless of weather outside.

The comprehensive airbag system includes dual front impact, dual front side impact, knee, and overhead airbags. STARLINK Safety Plus emergency communication services are included with a three-year complimentary trial.

Technology keeps you connected and informed. The 11.6-inch Subaru STARLINK multimedia navigation system provides intuitive route guidance and entertainment options. SiriusXM satellite radio and the 12-speaker Harman/Kardon audio system elevate your driving experience. Steering wheel-mounted audio controls allow you to manage entertainment without taking your hands off the wheel.

This well-equipped Outback is ready to serve your lifestyle. Whether navigating city streets or exploring remote locations, the combination of practical design, safety features, and comfort amenities makes this vehicle a solid choice for discerning buyers.

This 2023 Subaru Outback Premium delivers the reliability and capability you need, with the refinement and features you'll appreciate every day.

- Blind Spot Detection with Rear Cross Traffic Alert and Keyless Access with Push Button Start
- Hands-Free Power Rear Gate with automatic close and height memory
- Subaru STARLINK 11.6" Multimedia Plus System with SiriusXM
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with power driver seat adjustment
- Front Dual Zone Automatic Temperature Control
- Leather Steering Wheel and Shift Knob
- Rear Camera with Exterior Parking Capability
- Auto High-Beam Headlights with Front Fog Lights
- STARLINK Safety Plus Emergency Communication System (3-year trial included)
- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension with Speed-Sensing Steering
- Roof Rack for additional cargo capacity

The 2.5L four-cylinder engine paired with Subaru's CVT Lineartronic transmission provides responsive performance while delivering 26 mpg city and 32 mpg highway efficiency. The standard all-wheel drive system ensures confident handling in any weather condition, whether navigating city streets or heading out on weekend adventures. The Premium trim includes thoughtful conveniences like dual zone climate control and a heated steering wheel option to keep you comfortable throughout the year.

Inside, the cabin reflects quality construction with leather accents on the steering wheel and shift knob, cloth upholstery, and front bucket seats designed for all-day comfort. The split-folding rear seat expands your versatility for both passengers and cargo, while the hands-free power rear gate makes loading groceries or gear effortless. Storage solutions are integrated throughout, including front and rear center armrests with storage compartments and driver and passenger door bins.

Safety is built into every drive with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags working together with Subaru's EyeSight Driver Assist Technology features. The blind spot detection system alerts you to vehicles in your blind spots, while the rear cross traffic alert provides added awareness when backing out of parking spaces. Four-wheel independent suspension combined with traction control and electronic stability control delivers composed handling and strong braking performance through the four-wheel disc brake system.

Technology keeps you connected with the STARLINK 11.6" multimedia system providing access to SiriusXM satellite radio, AM/FM stations, and smartphone integration. The trip computer displays fuel economy and driving statistics at a glance, while steering wheel mounted controls let you manage audio and cruise functions without taking your hands off the wheel. STARLINK Safety Plus emergency communication is included with a three-year complimentary trial, offering additional peace of mind on every journey.

This one-owner Outback Premium has been well maintained and is ready to become part of your family. With its white exterior, 17-inch black aluminum alloy wheels, and practical roof rack, it's as capable as it is visually appealing. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience firsthand why the Outback remains a trusted choice for drivers who demand both substance and style.

The harman/kardon premium audio system with center speaker and subwoofer delivers quality sound, complemented by steering wheel-mounted audio controls and SiriusXM compatibility.

Connectivity features keep you engaged and informed. The navigation system integrates seamlessly with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, allowing hands-free access to your preferred navigation and entertainment applications. The trip computer and outside temperature display provide practical information at a glance.

Storage and cargo management benefit from purposeful design elements. The dual load floor cargo tray maximizes organization, while the dual level cargo board and cargo cover provide flexible options for securing and concealing items. The split folding rear seat adapts to your carrying needs, whether transporting passengers or maximizing cargo space.

The 2.0L I4 engine paired with a CVT delivers practical fuel efficiency, achieving 28 city and 33 highway miles per gallon. This powertrain balances responsiveness with sensible consumption for daily commuting and longer journeys alike.

Visit our showroom to experience this Gray GT-Line in person and see how its combination of safety features, comfort appointments, and practical design can serve your driving needs.

This 2019 Subaru Outback 2.5i Touring combines practical versatility with refined comfort for drivers who value both capability and quality.

- 12 Speakers with harman/kardon® Surround Sound Speaker System
- Subaru STARLINK 8.0" Multimedia Navigation System with Apple CarPlay/Android Auto
- Power Moonroof
- Heated Front Bucket Seats with Perforated Leather-Trimmed Upholstery

The white exterior presents a clean, timeless appearance that maintains its appeal in any season. Under the hood, a 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired with CVT Lineartronic transmission and all-wheel drive delivers a balanced driving experience with 25 city MPG and 32 highway MPG, making this Outback practical for both daily commutes and longer journeys.

The cabin welcomes you with heated front bucket seats wrapped in perforated leather, complemented by the power moonroof that floods the interior with natural light. The power liftgate and split-folding rear seat provide flexibility for cargo needs, while the power driver seat with memory settings ensures you'll find your perfect driving position every time.

Technology integrates seamlessly through the Subaru STARLINK 8.0" navigation system, which offers smartphone integration via Apple CarPlay and Android Auto. The 12-speaker harman/kardon audio system elevates your listening experience, while steering wheel controls keep your focus on the road. SiriusXM satellite radio adds entertainment options for extended drives.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc ABS brakes, and an exterior parking camera. The security system and panic alarm provide additional peace of mind, while low tire pressure monitoring helps maintain proper vehicle maintenance.

With 68,032 miles on the odometer, this Outback has been well-maintained and represents strong value for a buyer seeking a versatile, capable wagon. The combination of practical features, dependable all-wheel-drive performance, and modern conveniences makes this an excellent choice for active individuals and families alike.

Visit our showroom to experience this 2019 Subaru Outback firsthand and discover why it remains a trusted choice for those who refuse to compromise between adventure and everyday reliability.

The split-folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility for whatever you need to transport.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and a knee airbag positioned to protect occupants in various collision scenarios. Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control work together to maintain vehicle stability, while the four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering provide composed handling characteristics.

Practical touches throughout this Impreza enhance daily ownership. The exterior parking camera rear assists with backing up safely, while the rear window defroster and variably intermittent wipers handle challenging weather conditions. All-weather floor liners protect your interior investment, and the included cargo cover and cargo tray help organize and secure your belongings.

This 2019 Impreza represents solid value for buyers seeking a reliable, well-equipped compact sedan with proven all-wheel-drive capability. We invite you to schedule a test drive and experience its balanced combination of efficiency, safety, and practical features firsthand.

This 2019 Subaru Outback 2.5i Touring in white delivers the versatility and dependability you need for all your adventures. With practical design and solid construction, this vehicle is built to handle whatever comes your way.

The engineering behind this model prioritizes practicality and comfort. The 2.5L 4-cylinder engine pairs with a Continuous Variable Transmission for smooth, efficient performance. All-Wheel Drive provides confident handling across various road conditions, while the four-wheel independent suspension absorbs bumps for a composed ride. Whether you're navigating city streets or exploring rugged terrain, this Outback responds predictably.

Inside, the cabin combines comfort with technology. The heated front bucket seats and heated rear seats provide warmth during cooler months, while the power moonroof adds natural light and airiness. The 8.0" navigation system seamlessly integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping you connected and informed. The Harman/Kardon audio system delivers clear, rich sound for your daily commute or longer journeys.

Safety features include electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel disc brakes with ABS, and a comprehensive airbag system. The exterior parking camera rear assists with visibility, while the auto-dimming rear-view mirror reduces glare. These elements work together to help you drive with confidence.

At 25 city and 32 highway MPG, this Outback balances fuel efficiency with capability. The practical design includes a power liftgate, roof rack rails, and split-folding rear seats that expand cargo space when needed. With 56,259 miles on the odometer and regular maintenance, this vehicle has plenty of life ahead.

We invite you to visit and experience this Subaru Outback firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you find the right vehicle for your needs.

This 2019 Subaru Outback 2.5i Premium combines practical versatility with refined comfort, delivering a well-rounded vehicle for drivers who value dependability and capability.

- Blind Spot Detection (BSD) and Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA)
- Power Rear Gate with Automatic Close and Height Memory
- Subaru STARLINK 8.0" Multimedia Plus System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto
- Heated Front Bucket Seats
- All-Wheel Drive with 2.5L 4-Cylinder Engine
- Turn Signal Side Mirrors
- Automatic Temperature Control with Front Dual Zone
- Electronic Stability Control and Traction Control
- Exterior Parking Camera Rear
- Remote Keyless Entry
- Steering Wheel Paddle Shift Controls
- 17" Alloy Wheels
- Roof Rack
- Full-Time All-Wheel Drive System

The drivetrain delivers steady performance with a 2.5L 4-cylinder engine paired to a CVT Lineartronic transmission. All-wheel drive provides traction in varied conditions, while the suspension geometry supports both highway smoothness and off-road composure. Fuel efficiency comes in at 25 city and 32 highway miles per gallon, balancing capability with reasonable operating costs.

Safety features include dual front impact airbags, side impact protection, and an overhead airbag array. Electronic Stability Control, traction control, and ABS braking work together to help you maintain control. Blind Spot Detection and Rear Cross Traffic Alert provide additional confidence during maneuvering, while the rear parking camera offers visibility when reversing.

The interior emphasizes comfort and connectivity. Heated front bucket seats warm occupants during cold weather, while automatic temperature control maintains your preferred cabin climate. The STARLINK multimedia system integrates Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, keeping your smartphone applications accessible. Steering wheel audio controls allow you to manage functions without taking your hands from the wheel.

Practical storage and convenience features make daily life easier. The power rear gate opens and closes automatically with adjustable height memory, simplifying load management. The split folding rear seat expands cargo flexibility, and the roof rack adds exterior carrying capacity. Power windows, power steering, and remote keyless entry handle routine tasks efficiently.

This Outback white exterior combined with its balanced mix of features and capability makes it a solid choice for drivers seeking a dependable crossover vehicle. Come see it in person at our showroom.

This 2019 Subaru Outback 2.5i Premium delivers capable all-wheel-drive performance with the reliability of a clean, one-owner Carfax history.

- Radio: Subaru STARLINK 8.0" Multimedia Nav System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto integration
- Blind Spot Detection (BSD) and Rear Cross Traffic Alert (RCTA) for enhanced awareness
- Power Moonroof with auto-open/close and laminated UV-tinted glass
- Power Rear Gate with automatic close and height memory
- Auto-Dimming Exterior Mirror with approach light
- High Beam Assist (HBA) for improved nighttime visibility
- Auto-Dimming Rear View Compass Mirror with HomeLink
- Remote keyless entry and illuminated entry
- Heated front bucket seats with power driver seat adjustment
- Steering wheel paddle shift control switches

All-wheel drive comes standard, ensuring confident traction across varied road conditions throughout the year. The exterior displays a clean white finish complemented by body-color bumpers, a roof rack, and a rear spoiler for both style and utility.

Inside, the cabin offers a driver-focused layout with a telescoping and tilt steering wheel, cruise control, and comprehensive audio controls mounted directly on the steering wheel. Dual front zone air conditioning maintains comfort for all passengers, while the rear window defroster and heated door mirrors enhance practicality during colder months. The split-folding rear seat provides flexible cargo space for your lifestyle.

Safety remains prioritized with dual front impact airbags, front side impact airbags, overhead airbags, and occupant sensing technology. Electronic stability control, traction control, four-wheel independent suspension, and speed-sensing steering work together to deliver responsive handling and confident braking with four-wheel disc brakes and ABS.

The Subaru STARLINK navigation system features an 8.0" touchscreen display, voice-activated controls, Bluetooth connectivity for audio streaming and hands-free calling, and compatibility with iPhone and Android devices. The system also includes SiriusXM satellite radio with multiple subscription options to keep you connected throughout your journey.

This Outback represents balanced practicality, proven engineering, and genuine value for buyers seeking a dependable vehicle ready for any adventure.

- EyeSight System with pre-collision braking and adaptive cruise control
- Blind Spot Detection
- Rear Cross Traffic Alert

The 2.0L 4-cylinder DOHC engine paired with the CVT Lineartronic transmission provides a smooth, efficient driving experience. With an EPA rating of 28 city and 37 highway miles per gallon, this Impreza balances everyday efficiency with the capability you need. The gray exterior maintains a clean, professional appearance that works in any setting.

Inside, you'll find a comfortable cabin built for practical daily use. The heated front bucket seats provide warmth during colder months, while the front center armrest and split folding rear seat offer flexibility for passengers and cargo. The Subaru Starlink 6.5" multimedia system keeps you connected with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto compatibility, allowing you to access navigation, music, and communication seamlessly.

Safety is paramount in this Impreza. The EyeSight System uses advanced camera technology to monitor the road ahead, providing adaptive cruise control and pre-collision braking assistance. Blind Spot Detection and Rear Cross Traffic Alert help you navigate around other vehicles with confidence. Steering Responsive Fog Lights automatically adjust their angle as you turn, improving visibility in poor conditions. With dual front impact airbags, dual front side impact airbags, knee airbags, and overhead airbags, this vehicle provides comprehensive protection for all occupants.

The all-wheel drive system ensures confident traction in diverse road conditions, while the four-wheel independent suspension with front and rear anti-roll bars keeps handling predictable and responsive. Power steering and speed-sensing steering technology adjust to your driving speed for optimal control. Four-wheel disc brakes with ABS provide reliable stopping power in all situations.

This 2018 Impreza 2.0i Premium represents a well-equipped compact sedan ready for your next chapter. With its combination of practical features, safety technology, and efficient performance, it stands ready to meet your daily demands. We invite you to visit our showroom to experience this vehicle firsthand and discover how it can serve your transportation needs.

Overview

Kia s 2018 Soul compact wagon is a tempting choice for anyone seeking a boldly styled, fun-to-drive hatchback that s as easy on the wallet as it is on gas. Available equipment like a harman/kardon audio system and advanced driver-assist features make the choice all the more easy to live with.

Since its debut, owners loved everything about the Kia Soul except its lack of power. Well, that all changed in the model 2018 year with the introduction of a new turbocharged engine. With more power onboard, the 2018 Kia Soul wagon delivers in every area that matters. Its styling remains fresh and funky, and the interior provides room for five, or two people and a ton of cargo. Kia knows its intending audience is a young one, so Apple CarPlay and Android Auto are along for the ride, too. The 2018 Kia Soul competition is the Fiat 500X, Mazda CX-3 or Mini Cooper Countryman, the Chevrolet Cruze and Honda Civic hatchbacks.

Driving the Kia Soul

The Soul s driving experience is on par with similar cars like the Nissan Juke, Chevy Trax and Hyundai Elantra GT, but it s the turbocharged engine in this 2018 Kia Soul Exclaim that really wakes this car up. The Exclaim s on-road performance is further enhanced by firmer shock and spring settings along with a big 18-inch wheel/tire package. Cornering capabilities are better than one would expect from such a tall vehicle.

Interior Comfort

The 2018 Kia Soul wagon offers 5-passenger seating. Upholstery and trim get notably better as you climb the model ladder, with the Soul Exclaim getting contrast stitching on its cloth and leather seats, plus a sporty D-shaped steering wheel. Available dual USB ports allow you to recharge one phone while the other is used for Apple CarPlay or Android Auto. The Soul s boxy shape provides very good headroom for all passengers, and offers good cargo space, especially when you fold the rear seatbacks down. The pulsating speaker lights are pure whimsy.

Exterior Styling

You ll still immediately recognize Kia s Soul for 2018 for what it is, but there are minor tweaks to the exterior that distinguish from the first generation. Front and rear bumpers have changed a bit, with the Soul Plus getting body-color inserts, and the Soul Exclaim getting black. The Exclaim also distinguishes itself from its non-turbo mates with 18-inch alloy wheels, dual exhaust tips, HID headlights and LED fog lights updating an exterior already known for a quirky blend of function and fashion. The upright styling offers good cargo and passenger space, and the distinctive vertical taillights are practically the car s signature.

Favorite Features

TURBO POWER

Who doesn t love horsepower? With the 2018 Kia Soul 5-door wagon, you ll get all the power you need without sacrificing fuel economy. In fact, the turbocharged engine in the Soul Exclaim gets the best fuel economy of the Soul s three engines. The only penalty is the extra cost, but it s worth it.

APPLE CARPLAY AND ANDROID AUTO

With Apple CarPlay and Android Auto, your infotainment system will always be as up to date as the latest smartphone. Both systems allow you to access everything on your phone, such as the iPhone s Apple Music or Android s Google Maps.

Standard Features

The 2018 Kia Soul comes in three models: Base, Plus (+) and Exclaim (!). Base models include 16-inch alloy wheels, a new drive-mode function, and an updated audio system. They combine with preexisting features: air conditioning, tilt/telescoping steering wheel, 6-way-manual-adjust driver s seat, power windows and door locks and Bluetooth wireless technology. The standard engine is a 1.6-liter 4-cylinder connected to a 6-speed manual transmission, making the base model the only Soul available with a stick. Higher-level models come standard with more, like bigger engines, better interior materials, and larger wheels, including 18-inch alloys on the Exclaim.

Factory Options

Options vary by model level, with base models with an automatic transmission offering a Convenience Package that adds the UVO3 infotainment system with a rearview camera, and automatic headlights. Soul Plus offers the Primo Lit package that combines a panoramic sunroof, leather seats with power adjustments and heating and cooling in front, blind-spot detection, adaptive cruise control, autonomous emergency braking, lane-departure warning, and a bunch of other features. Then there s the Exclaim which, along with the turbo engine, offers a panoramic sunroof and a Technology package that adds most of what s in the Primo Lit package, along with a harman/kardon audio system.

description: This 2018 Subaru Outback 2.5i Premium combines capability with confidence, offering a refined driving experience for those who value both safety and practicality.- EyeSight System with Pre-Collision Braking and Adaptive Cruise Control- Blind Spot Detection and Rear Cross Traffic Alert- Lane Departure Warning & Sway Warning with Lane Keep Assist- Power Rear Gate with Automatic Close & Height Memory- High Beam Assist for enhanced nighttime visibility- Subaru STARLINK 8.0 Multimedia Plus System with Apple CarPlay and Android Auto- Heated and Power-Adjustable Front Bucket Seats- Heated Door Mirrors with Power Adjustment- Split Folding Rear Seat for flexible cargo configuration- Automatic Temperature Control with Front and Rear Dual Zone- SiriusXM Premium Audio System with 6 Speakers- Exterior Parking Camera with Rear View Display- Four-Wheel Independent Suspension for balanced handling- All-Wheel Drive for reliable traction in varied conditions- Roof Rack for expanded storage capabilityThe 2.5L 4-cylinder engine delivers steady performance paired with a CVT Lineartronic transmission that provides smooth acceleration and responsive handling. Combined with all-wheel drive, this Outback handles both daily commutes and weekend adventures with capable control. The 25 city and 32 highway fuel efficiency helps manage fuel costs while maintaining the power you expect.Safety remains central to this vehicle's design. The EyeSight System actively monitors road conditions, automatically adjusting throttle and braking to help prevent collisions. Pre-Collision Braking activates when obstacles are detected, while Adaptive Cruise Control maintains your set speed and distance from vehicles ahead. These technologies work seamlessly to reduce driver fatigue on longer drives.Inside, the Premium trim provides comfort through heated front seats and an eight-inch multimedia system that connects your smartphone for navigation and entertainment. Dual-zone automatic temperature control allows front passengers to adjust comfort independently, while the power rear gate simplifies loading and unloading cargo. The split-folding rear seat accommodates passengers or expands cargo space as needed.Visibility is enhanced through multiple safety features designed to address blind spots and challenging driving conditions. Blind Spot Detection alerts you to vehicles alongside, while Rear Cross Traffic Alert monitors traffic when backing. High Beam Assist automatically adjusts headlight intensity, and the rear view camera displays on your multimedia screen when reversing.This white Outback represents a mature approach to crossover ownership balancing everyday convenience with genuine protective technology and reliable all-weather capability. The combination of EyeSight safety systems, premium comfort appointments, and proven Subaru durability makes this an intelligent choice for the discerning buyer ready to invest in peace of mind. We invite you to visit and experience this vehicle firsthand.

description:
The 2013 Subaru Impreza 2.0i Limited stands out as a versatile hatchback featuring a one-owner history and a balance of practicality, comfort, and efficiency.

Buyers evaluating this hatchback are typically focused on all-weather confidence, flexible cargo space, and low running costs. The Impreza’s combination of AWD and split folding rear seats makes it well-suited for commuters, students, and young families who need adaptability, especially in regions with variable weather. Its one-owner status provides added peace of mind for researchers prioritizing verified history. Those who value heated leather seats, a moonroof, and straightforward controls will appreciate the Limited trim’s approachable luxury without unnecessary complexity.

Driving the Impreza reveals a composed and responsive character, thanks to its 2.0L 4-cylinder SMPI DOHC 16V engine paired with a CVT Lineartronic transmission. Acceleration is smooth and predictable, with the CVT delivering seamless gear transitions that benefit both city and highway driving. The AWD system enhances traction in rain or snow, making it a confident choice for year-round use. Four-wheel independent suspension and speed-sensing steering contribute to stable handling, while the hatchback body style ensures easy maneuverability in urban environments and parking lots.

Safety is a top priority in this vehicle, demonstrated by its comprehensive suite of active and passive systems. Standard equipment includes ABS brakes, electronic stability control, traction control, and brake assist, all working together to help the driver maintain control during sudden maneuvers or slippery conditions. Dual front, side, and knee airbags, along with occupant sensing technology, add layers of protection for all passengers. The inclusion of daytime running lights, fully automatic headlights, and fog lights improves visibility, enhancing confidence during night or adverse weather driving.

This Limited trim is equipped with an array of features designed for comfort and convenience. Leather-trimmed upholstery, heated front bucket seats, and an automatic temperature control system offer a premium cabin experience. The power moonroof with auto-open/close, auto-dimming mirror with compass, and steering wheel-mounted audio controls add daily usability. The audio system includes AM/FM radio, HD radio, a CD player, and six speakers for entertainment. Additional features such as remote keyless entry, split folding rear seat, and multiple storage compartments maximize utility for busy lifestyles and travel.

When measuring value, the Impreza distinguishes itself with AWD as standard—a rarity in the compact hatchback segment. This sets it apart from competitors like the Honda Fit and Toyota Matrix, which typically offer front-wheel drive only.

What are the key features of this vehicle? The Limited trim offers leather upholstery, heated seats, a power moonroof, and a comprehensive audio system. How does it perform in daily driving? The 2.0L engine and CVT deliver smooth acceleration and efficient operation, while AWD ensures year-round usability. What safety systems are included? ABS, electronic stability control, multiple airbags, and traction control help keep occupants protected.

Contact Bayway Chevrolet at (281) 997-5100 or visit 5719 Broadway St, Pearland, TX 77581 to schedule a test drive and experience the 2013 Subaru Impreza 2.0i Limited firsthand. Our team is ready to answer your questions and help you make an informed, confident decision about your next vehicle.
